top_signals.title: Trump Plans to Ease Limits on Tax-Exempt Diesel Variety
top_signals.summary:
Tom Kloza, chief energy advisor for Gulf Oil, said that it is unlikely President Trump's proposed easing of limits on tax-exempt 'red-dyed diesel' will do much to bring down the price of diesel and that the only thing that will meaningfully impact high prices is an end to ongoing conflicts in Russia and the MidEast. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Freeport LNG Ramps Up Gas Intake After Train 2 Shutdown
top_signals.summary: Freeport LNG was ramping natural gas intake back toward normal levels on Monday after maintenance shut one of its three liquefaction trains on Friday, putting a major source of U.S. natural gas demand on track to return to normal levels. Gas flows to the Texas LNG export plant were on track to reach 1.9 billion cubic feet per day on Monday, according to Reuters, citing LSEG data. That compares with an average of 1.2 bcfd from Friday through Sunday and matches the plant’s average intake during the week before the shutdown. Freeport told Texas…
